name: Álvaro Obregón
contribution: A Mexican general, inventor and politician who served as the 46th President of Mexico from 1920 to 1924.

checks.lead: Álvaro Obregón Salido (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈalβaɾo oβɾeˈɣon]; 19 February 1880 – 17 July 1928) was a Mexican general, inventor and politician who served as the 46th President of Mexico from 1920 to 1924. Obregón was re-elected to the presidency in 1928 but was assassinated before he could take office.
